sm_top.sm: The IDF sealed off and began evacuating homes of suspected terrorists in Hebron ahead of demolition.
The Houthis claimed attacks targeting a Saudi oil refinery and the defense ministry.
Russian strikes across Ukraine killed at least 20 people, including 14 in a railway station strike in Dnipro.
The United States advised Middle East allies to prepare for possible Iranian strikes following the midterms.
North Korea tests attack drones and tactical cruise missiles, vowing to deter threats.
Iran states that multiple oil tankers struck mines in the Middle East.
A drone strike on a market in Nyala resulted in varying casualty reports, ranging from dozens to over 100 deaths.
Ballistic missile and airstrike attacks in Aden triggered loud explosions and caused casualties, including reported deaths.
Russian forces launched over 100 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the surrounding region over a two-week period.
Houthi drone and missile attacks targeting Riyadh airport and other regions led to interceptions, casualties, and flight suspensions.
Russia intervenes on Iran amid tanker blasts in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards downed a US MQ-1 drone over the eastern Strait of Hormuz.
A missile attack triggers air defense alerts and explosions in Riyadh.
Casualties climbed following an Al-Shabaab attack on Somali army forces advancing near Burhakabo.
Israeli strikes in Gaza killed six Palestinians.
A Russian drone strike on a train station in Ukraine killed 14 people.
A Greek container ship sinks after a drone attack off the coast of Bulgaria.
Russia stated the war must continue following a massive Ukrainian drone attack targeting Moscow.
Attacks in Ethiopia's Oromia region killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians, according to the church.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile targeting western Saudi Arabia.
Saudi-led airstrikes in northern Yemen reportedly kill 14 people and wound 10 others.
Ethiopia took delivery of 12 Su-35 fighter jets and is set to receive S-400 air defense systems, PM Abiy announced.
Bandits attacked the Binnari community in Taraba State, killing 62 people and injuring 52 others.
Coalition forces intercepted a Houthi drone over the Makkah region.
The UN and the Red Cross reported that drone strikes in Sudan have killed hundreds of civilians.
Sudan accused Ethiopia of involvement in drone strikes targeting power stations and civilian sites.
Ukrainian air defense forces intercepted 97 Russian drones overnight.
Reports state that Donald Trump is prepared to initiate new bombing campaigns against Iran.
A Ukrainian drone attack hit Russia's largest steel plant, NLMK, causing a fire.
A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Omsk Region damaged industrial and chemical facilities and injured three people.
Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi oil, aviation, and military targets.
Iran claims the Strait of Hormuz is completely closed and warns that ships leaving the designated route will be damaged.
Ukrainian drones reportedly struck a Russian industrial plant deep inside Russian territory.
A Saudi-led airstrike killed 13 civilians in Taiz, Yemen.
Saudi-led coalition strikes kill 14 people in Yemen as Houthis target Aden airport with missiles.
Communal violence in South Sudan resulted in 84 deaths.
Ansarallah launched missile and drone strikes hitting a camp in Shabwa, resulting in dozens of fatalities among security personnel.
An employee at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant was killed in a drone attack.
The EU Council mobilises €4.9 billion under the European Peace Facility to support Ukraine.
Rights groups report that strikes on a Darfur market in Sudan killed more than 100 people.
